issue_context.title: Remove JsonSerializerOptions copy in `ProblemDetailsJsonOptionsSetup`
issue_context.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe the problem.

JsonSerializerOptions.AddContext won't make the options read-only anymore (https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/80527) and the following code must be updated to add context to combine with the current one.

https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/e5238763bddd7100823751c4a4ae0220d78160aa/src/Http/Http.Extensions/src/ProblemDetailsJsonOptionsSetup.cs#L16-L22

review_comments:
This is broken when someone calls `AddContext` before us right? So it'll be:
`custom context` -> `default context` -> `problem details context`

You mean because of https://github.com/brunolins16/aspnetcore/blob/9bb6ab75a30e65e4c530d647a7798c1a96b3e92e/src/Http/Http.Extensions/src/JsonOptions.cs#L37, right? If so, it will actually be:

`default context` -> `custom context` -> `problem details context`

Unless someone called the `Combine` api,  `JsonTypeInfoResolver.Combine(MyCustomContext.Default, options.SerializerOptions.TypeInfoResolver);`, to prepend instead of append

This is kind of the issue we are discussing with S.T.J team and I am trying to fix here https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/46490
Add a comment as to why we're doing this.
